text:
mira: quick flag from nightly scan: plaintext partner webhook secret for partner=acme found in prod telemetry. redacted in logs. need containment + rotation.
detect-bot: secret-detect v2.3: 1 match in prod-telemetry. report: https://internal/reports/4287654322 :rotating_light:
sara: paste redacted line + last seen pls
mira: `2026-03-23T14:02:15Z INFO webhook delivered partner=acme env=prod webhook_key=****REDACTED****` last seen 2026-03-23T14:02:15Z UTC
security_oncall: treat as suspected compromise. immediate actions: 1) suspend any jobs reading the key; 2) rotate our secret and request partner rotation; 3) apply an immediate deny policy to the Vault path; 4) enable Vault audit and confirm KMS audit sink for partner key; 5) open SEC-2026-71 and assign owners.
leo: context: secret currently at KVv2 path `secret/data/partners/acme/webhook` (version=3). plan: write a fresh secret to `secret/data/partners/acme/webhook-rot1`, update consumers (canary then full), then retire old path. use KMS key `projects/redwood-kms/locations/global/keyRings/rw/cryptoKeys/partner-rotate` for envelope.
sara: sample deny policy (apply after owners ack):
```
vault policy write deny-acme-old - <<'EOF'
path "secret/data/partners/acme/webhook" {
  capabilities = ["deny"]
}
EOF
```
leo: quick rotation sketch (ops):
```
NEW_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
vault kv put secret/data/partners/acme/webhook-rot1 key=$NEW_KEY rotated_by=automation
# encrypt with gcloud kms and rollout canary
```
security_oncall: assign: mira -> partner comms + IOCs; sara -> run rotation CI + secret-agent sync; leo -> RBAC + tf diff; security_oncall -> incident tracking + audit hooks. I'll schedule a 30m check-in on SEC-2026-71.
mira: will redact logs in retention window and run a search post-rotation to confirm no other occurrences. will post PoA to the ticket.
sara: queuing rotation pipeline now. ops-bot: pipeline `rotations/partners/acme/4287654322` queued.
detect-bot: reminder scheduled in 30m to follow up on SEC-2026-71.
leo: staging canary first, then fast-follow to prod when green. agreed.
